description: Author the actual Copilot customization artifacts that drive the gated loop: the Tier-0 universal instructions, Tier-1 portable prompt-file entrypoints, and the Tier-2 Agent Skills + custom agents (VS Code host) that implement ingest -> clarify -> modify -> test -> apply with a human-approval gate at every transition. These artifacts orchestrate the FEAT-002 ingestion engine and the FEAT-004 test loop; they contain instructions only (no LLM calls of their own).
steps: Write .github/copilot-instructions.md (Tier-0, universal). Keep it SHORT (it is sent on every request). It must encode: the five-stage loop; the hard rule that a human approves every stage transition; the anti-hallucination rule (if confidence < threshold, ask numbered clarifying questions, never guess); the token-efficiency rules (use the .apia/knowledge/ cache and retrieval, never dump the whole repo); the stack priority (Python, C++, C#, Groovy); and the hard constraint that no external LLM API may ever be called (model inference is the user's Copilot session; external DATA only via MCP/tool-use). Point to the on-demand skills/prompts for detail rather than inlining it.

Write Tier-1 prompt files in .github/prompts/: apia-ingest.prompt.md, apia-feature.prompt.md, apia-clarify.prompt.md, apia-test.prompt.md, apia-apply.prompt.md. Each has valid YAML frontmatter (description; agent; tools where relevant) and a short body invoking the matching stage, referencing .apia/scripts/ingest.py and the knowledge base. These are the portable manual entrypoints for JetBrains/VS where skills are not honored.

Write Tier-2 skill .github/skills/apia-ingest/SKILL.md: frontmatter name must be exactly 'apia-ingest' (matches dir), description <=1024 chars explaining it ingests/learns the project, and context: fork (token isolation for heavy ingestion). Body instructs: run .apia/scripts/ingest.py (off-model), summarize the knowledge artifacts, present the summary, and STOP at the approval gate for user confirmation/correction; fold corrections back into .apia/knowledge/.

Write Tier-2 skill .github/skills/apia-feature-loop/SKILL.md (name 'apia-feature-loop'): orchestrates clarify -> modify stages. Body: restate request, list assumptions, ask numbered clarifying questions until confidence met (anti-hallucination gate), produce a change spec, then a proposed diff grounded in .apia/knowledge/, STOPPING at each gate. Must instruct fetching external data via MCP/tool-use, never inventing it.

Write Tier-2 skill .github/skills/apia-test-authoring/SKILL.md (name 'apia-test-authoring', context: fork): generates regression + new tests, and when the touched code has no tests, generates characterization tests FIRST to pin current behavior before modifying. Uses the per-stack adapter (.apia/adapters/<stack>.yml) for test commands.

Write custom agents in .github/agents/ with scoped tools and handoffs that materialize the approval gates as buttons: apia-planner.agent.md (read-only tools: search/codebase, search/usages, web/fetch; produces plan/diff; handoff to implementer), apia-implementer.agent.md (edit + terminal tools; applies approved changes; handoff to tester), apia-tester.agent.md (terminal/test tools; runs existing + new tests). Each frontmatter: name, description, tools array, and handoffs with label/agent/prompt/send:false so the human reviews before the next stage.

Validate every authored artifact: a small checker (reuse or extend .apia/scripts) that parses YAML frontmatter of all SKILL.md/*.agent.md/*.prompt.md, asserts each SKILL.md name equals its directory name and matches ^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$, description present and <=1024 chars. Add this as a pytest test under .apia/scripts/tests/.
Verify no authored artifact instructs calling an external LLM API (grep).
acceptance_criteria: .github/copilot-instructions.md exists, is concise, and encodes the loop, per-stage approval gates, the clarify/anti-hallucination rule, token-efficiency rules, stack priority, and the no-external-LLM constraint.
Five prompt files exist in .github/prompts/ with valid frontmatter, one per stage.
Three skills exist (apia-ingest, apia-feature-loop, apia-test-authoring), each with name == directory name, valid frontmatter, and apia-ingest + apia-test-authoring use context: fork.
Three custom agents exist (planner read-only, implementer edit, tester test) with scoped tools and handoffs implementing the gates.
A pytest frontmatter-validation test passes, confirming every SKILL.md name matches its directory and the ^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$ rule and description length limits.
grep confirms no artifact references an external LLM endpoint.
verification: Run the frontmatter-validation pytest in .apia/scripts/tests and confirm it passes for all artifacts.
Run `grep -rniE 'openai|anthropic|chat/completions|external llm' .github` and confirm no external LLM calls are instructed.
Manually read .github/copilot-instructions.md and confirm it is short and contains all five required elements.
findings: Authored all FEAT-003 Copilot customization artifacts (declarative, instructions-only, no external-LLM calls). Tier-0: .github/copilot-instructions.md (~2.8KB, kept short; encodes the five-stage loop, per-stage human-approval gates, the anti-hallucination clarify rule referencing confidence_threshold in .apia/config.yml, token-efficiency rules, stack priority Python/C++/C#/Groovy, and the no-external-LLM constraint; defers detail to skills/prompts). Tier-1: five prompt files in .github/prompts/ (apia-ingest, apia-feature [clarify+modify], apia-clarify, apia-test, apia-apply), each with valid YAML frontmatter (description, agent, tools). Tier-2 skills: apia-ingest/SKILL.md and apia-test-authoring/SKILL.md both use context: fork; apia-feature-loop/SKILL.md; each name == its directory name. Added the characterization-test template at .github/skills/apia-test-authoring/templates/python_characterization_test.py.tmpl (referenced by python.yml). Tier-2 agents: apia-planner (read-only tools: search/codebase, search/usages, web/fetch), apia-implementer (edit/files, run/terminal), apia-tester (run/terminal, run/tests, search/codebase); each has handoffs with label/agent/prompt/send:false to materialize the approval gates. Added .apia/scripts/tests/test_artifacts.py (PyYAML-based) validating frontmatter: SKILL.md name == dir and matches ^[a-z0-9-]{1,64}$, description present and <=1024 chars, valid YAML, context:fork on the two heavy skills, agent tools/handoffs(send:false), planner read-only, prompt descriptions, and a no-external-LLM guard. Verification: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests -q` -> 22 passed (11 prior ingest + 11 new artifact). `grep -rniE 'openai|anthropic|chat/completions|external llm' .github` returns only prohibition lines ('Never call...', 'Do not call...'). Ran suites per directory per the pyapp pythonpath quirk (combined `pytest samples/ .apia/` fails at collection with ModuleNotFoundError 'calc'; samples pass when run from samples/pyapp with 4 passed). ingest.py still runs off-model emitting the 7 artifacts.
